name: CNNDetection (CVPR 2020) ResNet-50 blur+jpg
limitations: Weights are not committed; download blur_jpg_prob.pth via the CNNDetection repo (see its README 'Download the models' links) and place it at models/blur_jpg_prob.pth.
CNNDetection was trained on ProGAN outputs with blur+JPEG augmentation; published results show weak transfer to diffusion generators — a low score is not evidence of a real image.
The runtime resizes to 224px with ImageNet mean/std; the original paper evaluated center-crops of arbitrary sizes, so small or heavily cropped inputs may score differently.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
notes: Runtime 'torchvision' rebuilds the arch named in 'arch' with a num_classes head, strips 'state_dict_prefix' from checkpoint keys, and load_state_dict(strict=True).

The released blur_jpg_prob.pth stores keys under 'model.'; state_dict_prefix handles that wrapper. The companion blur_jpg_prob0.5.pth checkpoint also works — copy it in as the 'checkpoint' target instead.
The checkpoint path is relative to this profile's directory (models/); keep it out of git — it is covered by .gitignore.
